narrative_engine.thesis: trend up context (H4 stack up · D1 stack up · EMA spread 3.73 ATR · price holds above Day VWAP) set the LONG bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.2977-0.3145 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 0.2862; the first objective pays 2.29R at 0.3242.

plan.triggerRule: await bullish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 0.2977-0.3145
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.2862 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
